<!-- The RED tests (plan 01) already pin these exactly. Implement to match. -->

The LOCKED send-keys form (RESEARCH §2-§3, sure-scale/claude-code-auto-compact, MIT — technique only):
```
tmux send-keys -t %N -l "/compact"     # -l = LITERAL; bare /compact, NO summary arg
sleep 0.4                              # the paste-detector settle delay (load-bearing)
tmux send-keys -t %N Enter             # a SEPARATE call — never appended to the literal
```
Why the delay (RESEARCH §3, THE finding): CC's TUI treats a fast text burst as a paste ([Pasted text])
and an immediate Enter is absorbed as CONTENT, not a submit. The ~0.4s pause lets the paste window close so
Enter commits the slash command. Keep the delay + separate Enter even for bare `/compact` (§3.4 open
question — costs 0.4s, prevents the silent-absorb failure; the live gate D-09 confirms the final form).

The idle signal (RESEARCH §4): `tmux capture-pane -p -t %N | tail -8 | grep -q '❯'` — the ❯ prompt marker
in the tail = idle at an empty prompt (safe to send). Absent (spinner / streaming / half-typed) = busy.

Compose these EXISTING, byte-unchanged modules (read for the fail-closed idiom):
- registry.tmux_live_panes — the injected-`run` + `getattr(result,"returncode",1) != 0` fail-closed template.
- bridge._tmp(tmpdir) / bridge.STALE_SECONDS (60) — reuse the tmp-dir resolution + staleness window for the marker freshness.
- The marker sibling is `claude-ctx-{session_id}-nudged.json` in the same tmp dir (bridge.discover_sessions EXCLUDES it).
</interfaces>
